name: shorthop
description: A personal URL shortener on one Cloudflare Worker: edge redirects, click analytics, a private admin.
author: Jan Tegze (https://jantegze.com)

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: The admin password, at least 9 characters. Use a long random one (a password manager can make one): without Cloudflare Access, it alone protects the admin at `/_admin`. Change it later under the Worker's **Settings → Variables and Secrets**.

LINKS.description: KV namespace holding the published links, read on every redirect.

DB.description: D1 database: links, history, daily statistics, settings. Its migrations run on every deploy.

CLICKS.description: Analytics Engine dataset with one data point per click. To read it, add `CF_ACCOUNT_ID` and a `CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN` secret later ([docs/SETUP.md](https://github.com/jntegz/shorthop/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md#analytics)).

WEB.description: Analytics Engine dataset for website visits (Websites in the admin). Read with the same `CF_ACCOUNT_ID` and `CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN` as the click dataset.

CLICK_CAPS.description: Durable Object counting clicks exactly, used only by links with a click limit.

ADMIN_AUTH.description: Leave it as `password`. Any other value locks the admin until Cloudflare Access is set up ([docs/SETUP.md](https://github.com/jntegz/shorthop/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md#access)).

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Leave it empty. Only for Cloudflare Access, which you can add later.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Leave it empty. Only for Cloudflare Access, which you can add later.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Leave it empty. Only for Cloudflare Access, which you can add later.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Optional: your Cloudflare account ID, to read click statistics once you also add a `CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN` secret. Leave it empty if unsure; you can add it later.

SHORT_DOMAINS.description: Leave it empty for now. After the deploy you add your domain here, together with a route ([how](https://github.com/jntegz/shorthop/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md#deploy-button)).

ADMIN_HOST.description: Leave it empty: the admin then lives on your short domain.

FALLBACK_URL.description: Your own website, such as `https://www.example.com`. People who open the short domain itself go there. You can change it later.

KV_CACHE_TTL.description: Leave it at `60` (seconds): how long a link stays cached at the edge, so edits reach everyone within a minute.

AE_DATASET.description: Leave it as it is: the name of the click dataset above.

AE_WEB_DATASET.description: Leave it as it is: the name of the website dataset above.

WORKERS_PLAN.description: `free`, unless you pay for Workers ($5/month): then `paid`. It sizes bulk jobs to your plan's limits.

API_TOKEN_SCOPE.description: Leave it as `create`. Only for the older API token; new installs use API keys from the admin.

DIGEST_PROVIDER.description: Leave it as `off`. You can turn email on later in the admin: Settings → Statistics & email → Set up email.

DIGEST_FROM.description: Leave it empty. Email is set up later in the admin.

DIGEST_TO.description: Leave it empty. Email is set up later in the admin.

DEV_AUTH_BYPASS.description: Leave it empty. Only for local development.

DEV_AUTH_EMAIL.description: Leave it empty. Only for local development.

scripts.deploy: tsx scripts/setup/check-deploy.ts && npm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: tsx scripts/setup/wrangler-local.ts d1 migrations apply DB --local
